name: pip-workshop
description: A native Java learning app with guided practice, cumulative game projects, and an interactive robot simulator.

scripts.build:jre: rm -rf src-tauri/jre && jlink --add-modules java.base,java.compiler,jdk.compiler,jdk.zipfs --strip-debug --no-man-pages --no-header-files --compress=zip-6 --output src-tauri/jre && chmod -R u+w src-tauri/jre
